title: 第十章 自掘坟墓第十一章 战利品
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
铁锹大概不太好用，林间地面也不太好挖。
时而便有巨石拦路。
这老妪倒是一身神力，遇到这种情况，便骂骂咧咧的将那铁锹扔到一旁，蹲身下来就将那石头抱出来，随手扔到一旁。
久而久之，边上堆得土，竟然还没有石头多。
周青梅看的心头凝重，正要静观其变，就感觉身边一空，再抬头，方书文已经朝着那老妪走去。
心下一愣，连忙跟上。
此时那老妪已经跳进了坑里，方书文来到坑边，蹲下看着她。
老妪有所察觉，抬头看了他一眼。
她的发丝都被雨水打湿，贴在满是褶皱的皮肤上，眼神恶毒而又冷漠。
但她只是看了方书文一眼之后，就继续挖坑。
方书文则忽然开口
“用不用帮忙？”
跟在方书文背后的周青梅，险些一个趔趄摔在地上。
还以为方书文能说出什么惊人之语，现在竟然是打算去帮忙？
这老妪出现的莫名其妙，更没有什么正常人会在下着大雨的时候，在这样的林子里挖坑。
而在这样的情况下，头脑正常的人，怎么会想到要帮忙的？
想起周家密室的交谈，周青梅表情有些古怪
“这家伙，该不会真的脑内有疾？”
倒是那老妪摇了摇头
“不用。”

她的声音就好像是多年不曾修理的门轴，干哑又刺耳。
方书文也没有强人所难的意思，便蹲在那里继续看她挖。
周青梅站在他身边，看看坑里的老妪，又看了看方书文，最后用脚丫子轻轻碰了碰方书文的小腿
“她在挖什么？”
“挖坟。”
方书文低声回答。
“……”
这也能看出来？
老妪那叫人心神不宁的笑声响起
“小伙子，倒是好眼力。”
“还行，我少时什么乱七八糟的杂活都干过，也跟着帮人挖过坟。
“你这坑深有六尺上下，长七尺有余，宽约三尺半左右，最适合埋人。”
方书文笑着说道。
那老妪忽然抬头，看着方书文阴恻恻的厉声问道
“那你可知，老身要埋的人是谁？”
content_en:
The shovel is probably not very easy to use, and the forest floor is not easy to dig.
Sometimes there are huge rocks blocking the road.
This old woman was possessed of divine power. When faced with this situation, she threw the shovel aside with a curse, squatted down, picked up the stone, and threw it aside.
As time went by, the soil piled up on the side was not as much as the stones.
Zhou Qingmei's heart was solemn as she looked at it. Just when she was about to wait and see what happened, she felt that everything around her was empty. When she looked up again, she saw that Fang Shuwen was already walking towards the old woman.
I was startled and quickly followed.
At this time, the old woman had jumped into the pit. Fang Shuwen came to the edge of the pit and squatted down to look at her.
The old woman noticed something and looked up at him.
Her hair was wet from the rain and stuck to her wrinkled skin, and her eyes were vicious and cold.
But she just glanced at Fang Shuwen and continued digging.
Fang Shuwen suddenly spoke
"Do you need help?"
Zhou Qingmei, who was following Fang Shuwen, almost stumbled and fell to the ground.
I thought Fang Shuwen could say something amazing, but now he actually plans to help?
This old woman appeared out of nowhere, and no normal person would dig a hole in such a forest when it was raining heavily.
And under such circumstances, how could anyone in their right mind think of helping?
Thinking of the conversation in the Zhou family's secret room, Zhou Qingmei had a strange expression.
"Is this guy really mentally ill?"
But the old woman shook her head.
"No need."
Her voice was like a door shaft that had not been repaired for many years, hoarse and harsh.
Fang Shuwen didn't mean to make things difficult for anyone, so he squatted there and continued to watch her dig.
Zhou Qingmei stood beside him, looked at the old woman in the pit, then at Fang Shuwen, and finally touched Fang Shuwen's calf with her foot.
"What is she digging for?"
"Dig a grave."
Fang Shuwen replied in a low voice.
"..."
Can this be seen?
The old woman's unsettling laughter rang out
"Young man, you have good eyesight."
"It's not bad. I did all kinds of messy chores when I was young, and I also helped dig graves.
"Your pit is about six feet deep, more than seven feet long, and about three and a half feet wide. It is most suitable for burying people. "
Fang Shuwen said with a smile.
The old woman suddenly raised her head, looked at Fang Shuwen and asked sternly
"Then do you know who the person I want to bury is? "
